quote: We apply our method to natural language generation tasks and, for the first time, demonstrate low-bit generative transformers of competitive accuracy. Our ternary (weight and activation) model lags a full-precision BART model by only 4 points in ROUGE on the XSUM summarization dataset... We also evaluate our model on machine translation... On the WMT16 En-Ro benchmark...

We evaluate the effectiveness of our low-bit quantization scheme for natural language generative model on text summarization benchmarks: CNN/DailyMail and XSUM. ... We additionally experiment on the machine translation task with mBART on WMT16 English‑Romanian (En‑Ro) dataset.

We demonstrate that with the learning-based activation quantization method and statistics-based weight quantization scheme, the proposed TBT for the first time is able to quantize the BART model for natural language generation tasks to ternary and even binary weights and activations, and achieve reasonable accuracy on summarization and translation benchmarks.
outputs: Generated summaries for XSUM and CNN/DailyMail; generated translations for English‑Romanian.
